Inside your circle

For the way you
actually talk.

Some things need a group. Some are just between two people. Keep the conversation in one place.

01 / CONVERSATIONS

One person. Or the whole group.

Send a direct message or bring people into a group conversation. Reply to a message and react without losing the thread.

02 / MORE THAN TEXT

Say it your way.

Send a voice note when typing won't do. Share a photo or attach a file when the conversation needs more context.

03 / YOUR SETTINGS

Choose what you share.

Adjust profile visibility, last seen, and read receipts in your privacy settings. Block users when you need to.

On your device

Your browser.
A place for your circle.

Use Circlo on your laptop or phone. On Windows, you can also give it its own window using your browser's app installation option.

Open Circlo ↗

Use it as an app on Windows

1Open Circlo in Microsoft Edge or Google Chrome.
2In Edge, look under Apps in the browser menu. In Chrome, look for an install option or Open as window.
3Follow the browser prompts, then pin Circlo to your taskbar.

Options vary by browser version. Browser installation is not a separate Windows installer. An Android download is planned; it is not available here yet.

A few details

Before you
jump in.

A straightforward introduction to using Circlo. No promises about features that haven't shipped.

Do I need to download anything?

No. You can use Circlo in your browser. If you prefer a separate window on Windows, follow the browser installation steps above.

Can I use Circlo on my phone?

Yes, open Circlo in your phone's browser. This page does not currently offer an Android APK or a Play Store download.

Where can I find the privacy policy?

Read the Privacy Policy for information about your data. You can also manage privacy controls from your profile settings inside the app.

How do I get started?

Create an account, complete email verification, then sign in. If you already have an account, log in to return to your conversations.
